instruction: I want to give my presentation a more formal look by changing all text to 'Times New Roman' font and making it italic. Can you help me do this globally?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing all fonts to Times New Roman and making all text italic. Evaluator verifies both conditions with partial credit: 0.5 for correct font, 0.5 for all italic.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: 0.5 points for using only Times New Roman font, 0.5 points for all text being italic

llm_judge_reasons: Complete coverage: Evaluator checks both requirements (font=Times New Roman AND all text italic)
Correct state extraction: Getter properly iterates through all slides/shapes/paragraphs/runs to extract font names and italic status
Logical comparison: Metric correctly checks if fonts set equals {Times New Roman} and if all_italic is True
Appropriate partial credit: 0.5 for font + 0.5 for italic aligns with two-part instruction
Proper postconfig: File is saved with Ctrl+S before verification, ensuring changes are persisted
Edge case handling: Only counts non-empty text runs (run.text.strip())
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: Getter could handle None font.name values more explicitly - if run.font.name is None (default font), it adds None to the set which might cause false negatives if all text uses default Times New Roman rendering
Minor: Getter treats run.font.italic=None as False, which is reasonable but might miss inherited italic formatting in edge cases
